description:
Energy-community demo on the OctoSdkDemo model: a Basic/Tree of Salzburg
regions carrying operating facilities and their metering points, plus two
DataFlows that bring the tenant to life:

  Signal Simulation - polls every 10s, generates synthetic signals and writes
                      the scaled values onto two metering points.
  Create Customers  - generates synthetic customers, facilities and metering
                      points on demand
                      (octo-cli -c ExecutePipeline --identifier 66e309cd5b53add9b5cd386a).

Both run on the Mesh Adapter that System.Communication seeds
(rtId 670000000000000000000002): Simulation@1 ships with the Mesh Adapter SDK,
so no simulation plug adapter is needed. Enable Communication on the tenant
first, then deploy both DataFlows after installing.

Demo and training tenants only.
